title: Run a campaign recovery as a task graph: parallel reads, one writer
hypothesis: A paused-campaign recovery is serial work.
change: Fanned out the read-only reconciliation (investors in two halves, fresh replies, deliverability and copy) and kept every write with one owner.
result: Codex spent the night of 10-15 serially and left all three campaigns paused. As a graph it finished in about 90 minutes.
next_decision: Start any multi-part recovery by drawing the graph: reads fan out, writes stay single.
check: Before a recovery, list the reads that don't depend on each other and run them in parallel; one owner does every write.
